reports.title: KRAFT HEINZ REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS;

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: For fiscal year 2026, the Company is updating its outlook. The Company now expects:
•Organic Net Sales(1)(2) down 0.5 percent to down 1.25 percent versus the prior year. This outlook includes an approximate 100 basis point impact from incremental SNAP headwinds.

•Constant Currency Adjusted Operating Income(1)(2) down 16 percent to down 18 percent versus the prior year. This outlook contemplates Adjusted Gross Profit Margin(1)(2) that is now expected to be at the low end of the previously provided range of down 10 basis points to down 50 basis points versus the prior year, incremental investments of approximately $700 million compared to 2025, and an approximate 500 basis point headwind from lapping lower incentive compensation.

•Adjusted EPS(1)(2) is now expected to be in the range of $2.07 to $2.13. Additionally, the Company expects an effective tax rate on Adjusted EPS of approximately 23.5%, interest expense of approximately $890 million, and other expense/(income) of approximately $210 million of income for the full year.
•Free Cash Flow Conversion(1)(2) of approximately 110 percent.
